Dialogs and drawers (1)
Download scoped gradebook
  • Filter summary, learner count, columns, policy version and fictional data label
  • No live SIS write or final-grade acknowledgment
Return without applying changesDownload local sample
Permissions
  • Course-only instructor authority.
  • TA access requires assigned learners/questions, expiry and explicit extra grants; authoring defaults off.
  • TA cannot release, change policy or grant allowances.
Responsive
  • Desktop grid has sticky row/column headings and labelled horizontal scroll.
  • Narrow web uses learner picker plus assessment list and calculation drawer; show both total meanings before numerical detail.
Accessibility
  • Use semantic table headers and captions; offer row-focused reading mode instead of relying on spreadsheet keyboard behavior.
  • Every status has text; focused cell drawer has a heading, visible close control and restored focus.
Data
  • Cell records distinguish received/ungraded/missing/excused/held/released; totals name score set and grading-policy version.
  • TA receives only assigned learner/question cells and scoped examples, never full-course totals or roster. Local exports require instructor-reviewed columns and recipient scope.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • 27/30 held result changes staff total while Learner sees retains prior released calculation.
  • Excused work removes denominator; ungraded work is excluded; missing follows stated close/policy rule.
  • TA filters/export cannot reveal learners or questions outside current allocation.
Notes
  • NEW PROPOSED web template; legacy IDs/map unchanged.
  • HTML planning only; no backend/integrations.
